summary: Event rows use large native-size pose holds so stock three-copy playback reads as one sustained slow action. Crouch wait, bend-inspect, bent-knee refusal, head-down failure, and foreground victory hand are readable at 192x208.
accepted_warnings: Stock renderer plays non-idle rows three times; the optional version-locked macOS patch is outside the pet manifest
review victory hand was assembled locally due to image-generation network unavailability; silhouette is exaggerated for readability
